text: So here is the whole lesson on the graph and the model you have been using. Vmax from the plateau. Half it, across, down: K M, a concentration. Lower K M, higher affinity, and each enzyme's K M from its own half Vmax. Same enzyme with an inhibitor: competitive, in the active site, overcome by substrate, Vmax unchanged, K M increased, the curve merges at the plateau. Non-competitive, at another site, the active site changes shape, Vmax decreased, K M unchanged in this model. Both reversible: activity returns when the inhibitor leaves.
